run_lighteval_on_deployed_model: run a lighteval benchmark task against a deployed LLM model on a Matrix cluster
setup_matrix_cluster_and_deploy_app: setup a SLURM cluster and deploy an LLM application with multiple replicas via Matrix CLI
run_lighteval_with_custom_generation_par: run a lighteval evaluation with custom generation parameters like temperature and max tokens
run_lighteval_with_custom_tasks: run a lighteval pipeline evaluation using a custom tasks directory for benchmark datasets
cleanup_matrix_cluster_and_app: cleanup and remove a deployed LLM application and stop the Matrix cluster after evaluation
